status: IP66/IP67 design target - verification and certification pending
description: A non-rotating, load-bypass mast-head bridge containing the complete AM59-3S-64-64 in a welded dry chamber. A closed internal air loop transfers heat to a liquid loop; a separate floodable and self-draining wet bay rejects heat outdoors.

environmental_basis.normal_operation: Powered operation in outdoor dust, wind-driven rain, and splash after qualification.
environmental_basis.washdown: RF inhibited and +50 V amplifier power isolated. No connector may be unmated.
environmental_basis.temporary_immersion: Unpowered survival only at 1 m for 30 minutes, followed by drain, inspection, leak check, and controlled restart.
environmental_basis.claim_boundary: The complete assembled product is not IP66/IP67 or NEMA rated until a production-equivalent unit passes the specified tests.
environmental_basis.ip69_note: Add a separate IPX9/IP69K requirement if washdown means hot, close-range, high-pressure cleaning.
environmental_basis.nema_procurement_objective: NEMA 250 Type 6P construction practices where compatible with mass and corrosion requirements

materials.pressure_shell: 3 mm continuously welded 5052-H32 aluminum with external stiffening as required by FEA
materials.service_flange: 8-12 mm machined 5083 or 5052 aluminum, finish-machined after welding
materials.service_lid: 6 mm 5052/5083 aluminum preliminary plate with external stiffeners
materials.structural_frame: 6061-T6 aluminum plate and 30 x 30 x 3 mm square tube, with joint design pending analysis
materials.environmental_seal: One-piece 70 Shore A EPDM, 5.33 mm nominal section; compound subject to wash-chemical review
materials.finish: Chromium-free conversion coat plus UV-stable white or light-gray exterior polyester powder coat
materials.external_hardware: A4/316 stainless with galvanic isolation except at deliberate bonded joints
materials.bonding: Masked conductive lands and short tinned-copper bonding braids

amplifier.fan_model: ebm-papst 612 NGLE as represented by supplied STEP

sealed_enclosure.roof_slope_note: Production roof and shield require 3-5 degree drainage; conceptual CAD uses planar envelopes.
sealed_enclosure.pressure_boundary_note: All seams continuous. No stitch welds, rivets, folded-only seams, ordinary drain, or structural through-bolts.

service_lid.fastener_thread: M5 A4-80 captive screw into replaceable blind insert
service_lid.environmental_seal_note: Final gland, squeeze, flatness, lid stiffness, torque, and tolerances require selected-seal data and FEA.

cartridge.retention_note: Use all twelve OEM mounting points. Final screw engagement and torque require Microwave Amps approval.

internal_air_loop.note: Coil, blowers, baffles, and ducts are performance envelopes. Final fan/coil curves and installed airflow test govern.

liquid_loop.coolant: Inhibited propylene-glycol/water; concentration set by site minimum temperature and material review
liquid_loop.penetration_note: Welded or brazed metal tube penetrations only; no hose or service joint inside the pressure boundary.

wet_cooling_bay.note: Floodable and freely drainable. Fans and pumps are off for immersion unless released components explicitly permit energized immersion.

feedthroughs.panel_location: Fixed +X wall below the wet radiator
feedthroughs.high_power_rf: Qualified barrier-sealed feedthrough or factory-potted pigtail; 2998 MHz, +64 dBm peak, pulse, mismatch, altitude, and mated/capped ingress approval required
feedthroughs.preferred_high_power_family: 7/16 DIN-class if horn interface permits; no generic N bulkhead is released
feedthroughs.rf_input_and_samples: Barrier-sealed SMA feedthroughs with qualified mated and capped IP performance
feedthroughs.power_control: Keyed mixed power/signal environmental connector with current, inrush, temperature, and bundled-wire derating
feedthroughs.pressure_vent: Supplier-sized screw-in ePTFE vent rated IP68/IP69K, installed on a sheltered high vertical surface
feedthroughs.caps: Every external connector requires a tethered equal-rated cap
feedthroughs.strain_relief: All external cables independently supported from structure; connector bodies carry no cable bending load

sun_shield.note: Ventilated solar shield only; not part of the ingress boundary.

interfaces.lower_existing_plate_pattern: UNRESOLVED - survey BSM2-P-M201-AL2-00P on the actual assembly
interfaces.upper_rotator_pattern: UNRESOLVED - survey rotator base, pilot, dowels, and cable exit
interfaces.note: Blank lower and upper plates are intentional. Do not fabricate or match-drill until safety-critical interfaces and loads are verified.

qualification_targets.production_leak_screen: 100 percent correlated pressure-decay or tracer-gas test with the pressure vent temporarily blocked
qualification_targets.thermal: 300 W at 45 C ambient, solar, no wind, reduced voltage, fouling, and single-fault cases
qualification_targets.ingress: Separate IP6X, IPX6, and IPX7 tests on a populated production-equivalent assembly
qualification_targets.structural: FEA and physical proof for hydrostatic lid load, wind, mast overturning, transport shock, vibration, and all frame joints
qualification_targets.corrosion: Actual site salt, cleaner, UV, coating, and galvanic-couple exposure
qualification_targets.acceptance: No free water, dust, wet witness label, insulation loss, protective-bond degradation, thermal fault, or RF performance degradation

unresolved: Exact lower mast-plate and upper rotator interfaces and their structural allowables.
Horn and rotator mass, center of gravity, projected area, cable dynamics, and continuous-rotation requirement.
Released internal coil, external radiator, pump, blower, external fan, accumulator, relief, and coolant materials.
Released RF, power, control, pressure-vent, and sensor feedthroughs.
AM59-approved mounting orientation, screw engagement, installed airflow, case-temperature map, mismatch protection, and environmental warranty limits.
Final combined mass, wind area, mast/base moment, guying configuration, and transport/shock analysis.
